nodes.source_text: Electrocatalytic activities of Ce₂W₂O₉ for OER were assessed in an alkaline solution (1.0 M KOH, pH 14)... R-Ce₂W₂O₉ exhibited greatly enhanced OER activity, requiring a much smaller overpotential of 297 mV to achieve 10 mA cm⁻²... 351 mV at a current density of 100 mA cm⁻²... Tafel slope of 67.3 mV dec⁻¹... lower charge transfer resistance (2.8 Ω)... Cdl value of 11.7 mF cm⁻²... sustained a constant current density of 20 mA cm⁻² for 1000 h... Dv = 5.2 μV h⁻¹... after 5000 cycles, the polarization curve remained largely consistent... only an 11 mV shift at 20 mA cm⁻².

the activity of CeO₂/CC was still poor, with an excessively high overpotential of over 570 mV at a current density of 10 mA cm⁻². CeO₂ exhibited an unfavorable Tafel slope of 278.6 mV dec⁻¹... CeO₂ (0.7 mF cm⁻²).

nodes.description: OER LSV activation scans in 1.0 M KOH
nodes.source_text: the overpotential required by Ce₂W₂O₉ decreased rapidly as the number of linear sweep voltammetry (LSV) scans increased, achieving a stable polarization curve after 10 cycles. This suggests a potential reconstruction of the material's composition and structure during the early OER stages.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD pattern of Ce₂W₂O₉ shows all distinct diffraction peaks corresponding to Ce₂W₂O₉ phase (ICDD PDF 00-030-0314), pure cubic phase, space group P213.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The crystal structure of the catalysts was first investigated via X-ray diffraction (XRD). As shown in Figure S9 (Supporting Information), all distinct diffraction peaks identified in the XRD pattern of Ce₂W₂O₉ correspond well to the Ce₂W₂O₉ phase (ICDD PDF 00-030-0314), and the broad peak observed at ≈25° is attributed to the CC substrate.

nodes.characterization_summary: Uniform coral-like Ce₂W₂O₉ arrays formed on the surface of the cloth fabric fibers.
nodes.evidence_snippet: After calcination, the self-supported structure of the ZIF-L precursor was maintained, and uniform coral-like Ce₂W₂O₉ arrays formed on the surface of the cloth fabric fibers (Figure 2c...)

nodes.characterization_summary: Rough surface characterized by numerous pores; elemental distribution shows spatially uniform Ce, W, O, C, and N.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Figure 2d, the rapid evaporation of Zn species during high-temperature calcination resulted in a rough surface characterized by numerous pores... (Figure 2e).

nodes.characterization_summary: Distinct lattice fringes with interplanar spacings of 0.396 nm indicating the (111) facet of Ce₂W₂O₉.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-resolution TEM (HRTEM) images (Figure 2f) reveal distinct lattice fringes characterized by interplanar spacings of 0.396 nm, indicating the (111) facet of Ce₂W₂O₉...

nodes.characterization_summary: Periodic ordered atom arrangement consistent with crystal structure model of Ce₂W₂O₉ (111) surface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Complementarily, the aberration-corrected high-angle annular darkfield scanning TEM (AC-HAADF-STEM) image clearly verifies a periodic ordered atom arrangement (Figure 2g)...

nodes.characterization_summary: Spatially uniform distribution of Ce, W, O, C, and N elements in the porous Ce₂W₂O₉ layer.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) mapping was used to analyze the elemental composition of the porous Ce₂W₂O₉ layer, revealing a spatially uniform distribution of Ce, W, O, C, and N (Figure 2e).

nodes.characterization_summary: Confirms presence of N-doping in the outer carbon layer.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Moreover, the Raman spectrum (Figure S15, Supporting Information) and the N 1s spectrum (Figure S16, Supporting Information) confirm the presence of N-doping in the outer carbon layer.

nodes.characterization_summary: R-Ce₂W₂O₉ exhibits lower charge transfer resistance (2.8 Ω) than reference samples.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Nyquist plots (Figure 3d) revealed that R-Ce₂W₂O₉ exhibited lower charge transfer resistance (2.8Ω) than the reference samples...

nodes.characterization_summary: Double-layer capacitance Cdl of R-Ce₂W₂O₉ is 11.7 mF cm⁻² vs 0.7 mF cm⁻² for CeO₂, indicating larger electrochemical active surface area (ECSA).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The double-layer capacitance (Cdl) value was determined from cyclic voltammetry (CV) curves acquired at varying scan rates (Figure S19, Supporting Information). R-Ce₂W₂O₉ demonstrated a markedly higher Cdl value of 11.7 mF cm⁻² than CeO₂ (0.7 mF cm⁻²), indicating a larger electrochemical active surface area (ECSA).

nodes.characterization_summary: Pristine Ce₂W₂O₉ shows Raman bands at ≈285 and 898 cm⁻¹ attributed to tungsten oxide structure; at 1.58 V, broad peak at 500-600 cm⁻¹ corresponds to Ce-*O species indicating surface reconstruction.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Pristine Ce₂W₂O₉ without any applied external voltage, exhibited Raman bands at ≈285 and 898 cm⁻¹... Concurrently, a broad peak appears in the range of 500-600 cm⁻¹ as the potential increased to 1.58 V...

nodes.characterization_summary: Ce L₃-edge XANES of R-Ce₂W₂O₉ shows white line positive shift and more pronounced Ce⁴⁺ feature at ≈5737 eV vs Ce₂W₂O₉; Ce⁴⁺ concentration increases from 20.5% to 33.7%.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Figure 4a, the X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) spectrum at the Ce L₃-edge... For R-Ce₂W₂O₉, the white line exhibits a positive shift toward higher energy compared with Ce₂W₂O₉, alongside a more pronounced Ce⁴⁺ feature at ≈5737 eV, indicating an elevated Ce valence after OER.

nodes.characterization_summary: High-resolution Ce 3d XPS confirms increase in Ce⁴⁺ concentration after OER; O 1s shows OH_L percentage rising from 13.2% to 35.4%.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) further corroborated these results. As shown in Figure 4c... After OER, the peak corresponding to OH_L displayed a notable increase in its percentage, rising from 13.2% to 35.4%.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ce L₃-edge EXAFS shows two Ce-O coordination peaks (1.5-2.6 Å) with reduced intensity after OER indicating enhanced structural disorder.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the extended XAFS (EXAFS) spectrum at the Ce L₃-edge (Figure 4d), two pronounced peaks ranging between 1.5 and 2.6 Å indicate Ce-O coordination.

nodes.characterization_summary: Notable reduction in W concentration in samples after OER confirms W dissolution and vacancy formation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: This dissolution phenomenon was confirmed by inductively coupled plasma-optical emission spectrometry (ICP-OES), which revealed a notable reduction in the W concentration in the samples after OER...

nodes.characterization_summary: W L₃-edge XANES of Ce₂W₂O₉ and R-Ce₂W₂O₉ located between WO₂ and WO₃ references with white line intensities akin to WO₃; R-Ce₂W₂O₉ shows marginally reduced intensity and negative shift indicating slight decrease in W oxidation state.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As for the W species (Figure 5a), the W L₃-edge XANES spectra of Ce₂W₂O₉ and R-Ce₂W₂O₉ are located between those of the WO₂ and WO₃ references.
